2.4.1 Data Collection: Graded Exercise Test
1.	 All students should fill out and electronically submit a 2021 PAR-Q+ (available online as a 
fillable form) prior to participating in any laboratory exercise activities.  
2.	 Designate team members for the following tasks (rotate tasks across the three tests within 
your team):
•	 Perform the exercise test (this will be “the participant”)
•	 Keep time and indicate when ratings of perceived exertion (RPE) should be taken and 
treadmill speed and grade should be changed.

L A B O R A T O R Y 2
•	 Record time, treadmill speed and grade, HR, 
and RPE on the data sheet
•	 Control treadmill speed and grade in addition 
to watching and communicating with the 
participant during the test
•	 Get mouthpiece, Rudolph valve, and nose clip 
rinsed and in hot soapy water after test 
3.	 The participant will put on an HR monitor and 
warm up on a treadmill (or a cycle ergometer) at 
a self-selected low to moderate intensity for at 
least 5 minutes. Time this so that the warm-up is 
completed 2-3 minutes before beginning the 
exercise test for the lab. Heart rate should return 
to near resting levels before beginning the 
graded exercise test.
4.	 Use the data sheet to calculate age predicted 
HRmax (APHRmax) and HR at 85% of AP
